title: One-Block Stabilizer Notation
body_html:
One-Block Stabilizer Notation

Let \(K_M=K\times K'\), with the corresponding positive-depth and pro-unipotent subgroups on both factors. Define \[ S=\operatorname{Stab}_{K_M}(w+B_0). \] For each active index \(i\), define \(S^i\) and \(S_C^i\) by intersecting \(S\) with the corresponding Moy-Prasad product subgroups.

The conjugation map \(\alpha:G_x^0\to G'{}_{x'}^0\) is extended on the pro-unipotent part by \[ \alpha(g\exp X)=wgw^{-1}\exp(d\alpha(X)). \] This extension need not be a group homomorphism. The diagonal sets are \[ \Delta^0=\{(g,\alpha(g)):g\in G_x^0\}, \qquad \Delta^i=\{(g,\alpha(g)):g\in G^i_{x,s_{i-1}}\} \] with corresponding plus-depth versions \(\Delta_C^i\).
